description: agensio v0.1.0-alpha.20: a static-file and reverse-proxy server on standalone Asio with its own HTTP/1.1, TLS and HTTP/2 layers, one event loop per worker and a lock-free per-worker index over one shared file cache. Static files from /data/static; HTTP/1.1 on :8080, h1 over TLS on :8081, h2 on :8443. No HTTP/3 yet, and the baseline and JSON endpoints wait for the benchmark handler module of the next release.
